en: The postcard features a sepia-toned photograph of a serene natural landscape with a small pond in the foreground, surrounded by grassy banks and trees. In the background, a villa-style house is visible, partially obscured by trees. A solitary figure, possibly a child, can be seen near the house. The reverse side of the postcard includes divided sections for correspondence and address, with the publisher information 'Aufnahme u. Verlag von Ernst Herrmann, Bad Pyrmont.' It also features the stamp 'Museum im Schloss' and a handwritten '2/3' and '12' in blue and black pencil.
